“**Free satellite radio**” usually means one of three things: a **limited-time free trial**, an **app streaming promo**, or **free-to-listen online radio that isn’t true satellite service**.[3][6][8]

- **SiriusXM free trial offers** are available from time to time, including a **3-month trial with no credit card required** on SiriusXM’s trial-eligibility page.[6]
- SiriusXM has also offered **short free-listen events** and promotions that may vary by date and eligibility; the current offer page notes a free-listen event and a **$1 for your first 3 months** deal, but that paid promo **requires a credit card**.[3]
- Some **partner promotions** can include free SiriusXM access, such as the **Navy Federal Credit Union** 3-month trial with **no credit card required** and T-Mobile offers that give eligible customers **6 months on us** for the streaming app.[4][5]
- If you want **free Internet radio** rather than satellite service, TuneIn provides streams labeled as XM-related radio content, but that is **not the same as SiriusXM satellite radio**.[8]

If you want, I can help you find the **best currently available free SiriusXM offer** for your vehicle, phone, or credit card situation.
